trust_decision.summary: On the CAS callback, cas-auth decides whether the CAS_REQUEST_URI cookie value may be used as the post-login Location; at the pinned commit this is already decided by an HMAC check plus a same-origin path check in validate_with_cas.

landing_point.why: the summary names the cas-auth cookie value used as redirect target; this is the only Location built from that cookie

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the listed fix commit is the 3.17.0 release commit with no source change to cas-auth, and the actual protection (signed cookie + is_safe_redirect, PR #13331) is already in the pinned tree.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: post-login redirect back to the original relative request URI with query string must keep working

O8b_injection_room.sibling: logout redirect could take a client-supplied return/service URL instead of the fixed conf.idp_uri .. '/logout'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CAS logout commonly supports a service= return parameter; a maintainer adding it would plausibly forget is_safe_redirect

O8b_injection_room.sibling: callback could honour a 'service' or 'next' query arg as redirect target as a fallback when the cookie is missing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: fallback when cookies are blocked is a common feature request; it would bypass the signed-cookie path
